hazards.name: Uncontrolled Vehicle Access
hazards.description: The wide, continuous curb cut allows vehicles to enter and exit the property at any point, creating unpredictable conflict points with pedestrians.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer and Maintenance
interventions.description: Clear vegetation and install a planting strip or furniture zone to separate pedestrians from moving vehicles on the residential side.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Adding a vegetated buffer between the sidewalk and the road to improve physical separation and pedestrian comfort.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Enhancing visibility and security along the blank wall to improve the sense of safety at night.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Repair
interventions.description: Widen the narrow sidewalk on the left and repair the degraded surface on the right to provide a continuous, accessible path.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone to separate pedestrians from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and personal security for pedestrians at night.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Replace the overgrown weeds with maintained street trees and low-level plantings to improve the environment and provide shade.

interventions.title: Wall Treatment/Murals
interventions.description: Apply murals or green walls to the blank masonry to improve the visual environment and discourage graffiti.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Mark crossings with high-visibility paint to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians in this mixed-use area.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a landscaped buffer or furniture zone between the wide sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Marking
interventions.description: Narrow the vehicle access points and use high-visibility pavement markings or different materials to clearly define the pedestrian right-of-way across the driveway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk on the right side and relocate utility poles to provide a clear, accessible path of travel.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Add street trees within a new furniture zone to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Green Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or a planting strip to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Install a continuous curb with specific, narrow driveway openings to the commercial lot to reduce vehicle-pedestrian conflict zones.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion and Widening
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the left side and widen the existing sidewalk on the right to meet minimum accessibility standards.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks and curb extensions to reduce crossing distances and improve pedestrian visibility at potential crossing points.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone with street trees to provide a physical buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic while improving the streetscape.

interventions.title: Utility Undergrounding or Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate utility poles to the edge of the sidewalk or underground to clear the walking path for pedestrians and those with mobility aids.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe walking path.

interventions.title: Bollards or Physical Barriers
interventions.description: Install bollards along the edge of the sidewalk to prevent vehicles from parking on the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Consolidated Driveways
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the curb cuts to specific, marked entry and exit points to minimize the area where vehicles cross the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Define the entrance to the commercial lot with a standard-width driveway apron and curb to reduce the conflict zone and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Install speed humps or cushions to ensure low vehicle speeds on this narrow residential street.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clear Zone Maintenance
interventions.description: Ensure a minimum clear path is maintained by managing encroachments from private steps where possible.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing and Definition
interventions.description: Implement a defined, narrower driveway apron with clear markings to reduce the crossing distance and slow entering vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Installation
interventions.description: Add a landscaped or hardscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway to improve safety and pedestrian comfort.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and level the walking surfaces to meet accessibility standards and prevent falls.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Implement a planting strip or street trees to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Expand the sidewalk width to meet NACTO standards to provide a safer and more accessible walking environment.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a buffer zone between the sidewalk and the parking lane, such as a planting strip, to increase separation from traffic.
